title: The Case of the Invisible Hands
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: 1930s art deco film-noir jazz, no vocals.
ambience: Quiet office floor at night, soft air conditioning hum, distant city, no music.

shots.say: Case seven. Every chatbot you have ever talked to has a backstage. And someone is always working back there.

sfx.prompt: Quiet empty jazz club after hours, glasses clinking softly, faint murmur

shots.say: January twenty twenty-three. TIME reporter Billy Perrigo revealed how OpenAI made ChatGPT less toxic.

sfx.prompt: Distant city traffic and a faint siren at night seen from high above

shots.say: Through an outsourcing firm called Sama, workers in Nairobi labelled tens of thousands of snippets of harmful text, so the model could learn what not to say.

ov.sub: teaching the model what not to say

sfx.prompt: Many people typing quietly on keyboards in a large open office, mouse clicks

shots.say: Their take-home pay: about one dollar thirty-two to two dollars an hour. Workers told TIME the content left them mentally scarred. Sama disputed some figures, and ended the contract eight months early.

ov.label: take-home pay, up to $2 by seniority

ov.sub: and ended the OpenAI contract early (Feb 2022)

sfx.prompt: A few coins dropping slowly onto a wooden table

shots.say: AI looks automatic. It isn't. Behind every polite answer are people, and their dignity is part of the product.

ov.text: THEIR DIGNITY IS PART OF THE PRODUCT

sfx.prompt: Warm low electrical hum swelling gently, hopeful, airy

shots.say: So next time a machine sounds polite, remember who taught it. Case closed.

sfx.prompt: Wind on a high city rooftop at dusk, distant traffic far below
Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
